lesson: The system is consistently attempting to counter-trend trade against a dominant macro downtrend, resulting in 10 consecutive stop-outs as liquidity sweeps fail to initiate reversals. The reliance on low-timeframe BOS and CHoCH signals is ignoring the overarching bearish structural integrity, leading to premature entries in a falling knife scenario.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'Trend Filter' rule that prohibits all LONG entries unless the 4h EMA alignment is bullish, regardless of lower-timeframe BOS signals.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less on LINKUSDT when the macro trend is strongly bearish.
